description: Kalpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha - Missed List of the Roads and Lanes of the Kalpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notification deals specifically with land and property matters - the declaration of roads and lanes as owned by the Kalpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha. It includes detailed schedules of specific roads with coordinates, lengths, and widths, addresses land ownership claims and procedures, and concerns property rights and land administration under the Pradeshiya Sabha Act. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land ownership, property boundaries, and land administration matters.
